verdict.rationale: Grok Build is itself a coding agent, so it plays the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The evidence shows only client-side MCP support (`grok mcp add`, loading `.mcp.json` configs) and an ACP agent mode over JSON-RPC. ACP is not an MCP server mode, and there is no `mcp serve` subcommand or hosted MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
